jobs.title: Software Engineer — Smart Construction 3D
jobs.description: **Build software that changes how the physical world gets built.** At EARTHBRAIN, we're building technology that transforms construction jobsites into intelligent, connected environments. Born from Komatsu—one of the world's largest construction equipment manufacturers—and backed by Komatsu, NTT, Sony, and Nomura Research Institute, EARTHBRAIN combines the speed and ownership of a technology company with the resources and global reach of established industry leaders. Our Smart Construction platform is already deployed across more than 15,000 jobsites in Japan and used in more than 27 countries. Now we're expanding our North American engineering team—and we're looking for experienced software engineers who want to work on technical problems that go far beyond the typical web application. You'll help build 3D products that allow contractors to combine CAD files, aerial and satellite imagery, drone\-captured point clouds, terrain data, and other project information to visualize, analyze, and plan complex construction projects. Think centimeter\-level terrain precision, massive geospatial datasets, earthwork calculations, digital twins, and interactive 3D environments. And that's only where we're starting. Our longer\-term roadmap includes remote and autonomous construction, with cloud systems coordinating fleets of heavy machinery across jobsites. **Why this role is different** This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who wants meaningful technical ownership. You'll write and ship production code every day, work across the stack, solve challenging 3D and geospatial problems, and see your work used in real\-world construction environments. You'll also join an engineering organization actively redefining how software gets built with AI. We believe great engineers don't compete with AI—they learn how to direct it. Every engineer has access to modern AI development tools, including Claude Code, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini. AI agents contribute meaningfully to first\-draft code and testing, while engineers remain responsible for architecture, technical judgment, review, quality, and what ultimately ships. Our interview process reflects how we actually work: **our technical interview is AI\-assisted, and you're encouraged to use the tools you use in your real development workflow.** **What you'll own** You'll:* Design, build, test, document, and continuously ship production software. * Build customer\-facing 3D experiences that help contractors understand and manage complex projects. * Work across the stack, from CesiumJS rendering in the browser to cloud\-based geospatial data pipelines. * Solve problems involving terrain, imagery, point clouds, CAD data, visualization, and large\-scale geospatial datasets. * Use AI coding agents as part of your daily engineering workflow—and critically review, refine, and improve their output. * Own features from initial technical design through production. * Improve engineering quality through thoughtful code reviews, pair programming, testing, and technical collaboration. * Collaborate directly with engineering teams in Japan as part of one global product organization. * Help shape the technical practices and culture of our growing North American engineering team. **Technology you'll work with** You don't need to be an expert in every technology below. We're more interested in strong engineers who can learn quickly and make sound technical decisions. **Application \& Data** JavaScript · TypeScript · Lit · React · CesiumJS · Node.js · GraphQL · Python · C\+\+ · GDAL **Testing** Jasmine · Karma · Vitest · Playwright · GoogleTest **Cloud \& Infrastructure** AWS · Google Cloud · Terraform · Docker **Build \& CI/CD** GitHub Actions · Vite **AI Development** Claude Code · ChatGPT · GitHub Copilot · Gemini **What we're looking for** You may be a strong fit if you have:* **5\+ years of professional software development experience** building, shipping, and supporting production systems. * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience with at least part of our technology stack. * The ability—and curiosity—to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly. * Experience incorporating AI development tools into your day\-to\-day engineering workflow. * The technical judgment to recognize where AI\-generated solutions work well, where they don't, and when human intervention matters. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Experience collaborating effectively across teams, disciplines, and time zones. * A computer science degree, related technical degree, or equivalent practical experience. * Authorization to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship. * Ability to work from our Philadelphia office at least two days per week. **Even better if you've worked with*** WebGL, GIS, mapping, or 3D graphics technologies such as CesiumJS, Three.js, or deck.gl. * Large datasets, particularly point clouds, imagery, terrain, or other geospatial information. * AWS and Docker\-based development environments. * Globally distributed engineering organizations. * Construction, mining, agriculture, robotics, heavy equipment, or other industrial technology. **Don't check every box?** If you're a strong software engineer who is excited about 3D technology, geospatial systems, AI\-assisted development, or building software that interacts with the physical world, we still want to hear from you. **What you'll get** Beyond the opportunity to work on technically challenging products with global reach, EARTHBRAIN offers:* Competitive compensation. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. * Short\- and long\-term disability coverage. * Company\-paid life insurance. * 401(k) retirement plan. * Generous paid time off and sick leave. * Free lunch, snacks, and drinks in the office. * Professional development through workshops, jobsite experiences, global hackathons, and Udemy courses. * Opportunities to travel to Japan and collaborate directly with our Tokyo engineering organization, including participation in our Global Tech Meeting. * A flexible, inclusive, multicultural working environment. **Build something you can see in the real world.** A lot of software moves information around a screen. Ours helps move earth, coordinate equipment, model entire jobsites, and ultimately change how construction gets done. If you want your next engineering challenge to combine **3D visualization, geospatial technology, cloud systems, AI\-assisted development, and real\-world impact**, we'd like to meet you. **Equal Employment Opportunity** EARTHBRAIN is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression. pbq7SyiBZe

jobs.title: Product Applications Engineer-Silicon Debug & Embedded Systems
jobs.description: Overview: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. Responsibilities: **THE ROLE** ------------ Join our team to drive customer success on AMD Adaptive SoC and AI Edge devices across a broad range of customer applications. You will be a technical point of contact for customer cases, from early design\-in and bring\-up through production support. The role is weighted toward silicon debug: finding and closing issues while the customer's design is still being brought up and characterized, so nothing surprises them at ramp. You will root\-cause failures across the processing subsystems, interconnect, memory and boot path, and drive each fix with the design, IP, firmware, software and field teams that own the pieces. You will also own the embedded Linux release and the documentation customers build from. Both halves matter, because the failures worth your time rarely sit cleanly on one side of the hardware/software boundary. **THE PERSON** -------------- You have a passion for system architecture, silicon debug, and embedded systems design. You are comfortable working across the full stack, from memory controller specifications and timing reports to building Linux images from source. You are drawn to problems that arrive without a clear owner or a clear root cause, and you are systematic about narrowing them down. You are a self\-starter: you can pick up an unfamiliar tool or flow and make progress on your own, and you know when to bring in the right specialist rather than stall. You are a team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills and experience collaborating with engineers located in different sites and timezones, and you can hold a technical conversation directly with a customer. We place a high value on technical writing. You produce documentation a customer can follow independently, and you can present a complex technical finding clearly to both engineering and customer audiences. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------ **Customer Support and Solutions:** Own escalated customer support issues, from pre\-production bring\-up and characterization through production support. Reproduce the failure, isolate it to a block or a layer, and drive it to a validated fix with the design, IP, firmware, software or validation team that owns it. Debug at the register level over JTAG, by boot stage, and against timing reports. **System Level Integration:** Work across the whole device, covering processing subsystems, Network\-on\-Chip, memory controllers (DDR5/6, LPDDR5/6\), boot and storage (OSPI, UFS, SD/eMMC), and programmable logic. Integrate and configure these subsystems in Vivado and Vitis, and generate the device images, hardware handoff (XSA) and system device tree that the software build consumes. **Technical Documentation and Customer Communication:** Author the customer documentation set, including product guides, user guides, datasheets and tutorials, and respond to technical escalations. **Performance Analysis and Tuning:** Isolate bottlenecks across the hardware/software boundary. Understand the configuration levers available at each layer, explain the expected cause and effect before changing one, and prove the result by measurement. **Embedded System Development:** Build and customize embedded Linux images with the Yocto\-based Embedded Design Flow, covering BSPs, device trees, kernel and rootfs tuning, and custom recipes and layers. Generate and debug boot images across the boot chain, and write low\-level software for the on\-chip processors. **Design Validation:** Develop RTL in SystemVerilog/Verilog and prove it on hardware. Build the test designs, automation and results analysis needed to validate a feature, and debug customer designs when they do not behave as expected. **Apply AI to Engineering Workflows:** Use AI/LLM/ML tools to surface design gaps, summarize and correlate large test and log datasets, and drive productivity in debug, automation and documentation. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** ------------------------ * Extensive hands\-on experience with FPGA/SoC platforms in a silicon debug, applications, validation, or systems engineering role, built across multiple device generations and product cycles. * Working knowledge of end\-to\-end SoC architecture: processing subsystems, on\-chip interconnect, memory controllers (DDR5/6, LPDDR5/6\) with their scheduling, arbitration and QoS behavior, boot and storage blocks (OSPI, UFS, SD/eMMC), and programmable logic. * Excellent technical writing, with a track record of authoring and publishing customer\-facing documentation that an external audience builds from: product guides, user guides, datasheets and tutorials. * Proven functional failure debug on real hardware: reproducing intermittent and system\-level failures, isolating them across the hardware, firmware and software boundaries, and driving them to root cause using register\-level JTAG debug (xsdb or equivalent), serial console, ILA, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. * Solid RTL fundamentals in SystemVerilog, Verilog, and/or VHDL. AMD/Xilinx FPGA experience preferred, with strong skills in Vivado or an equivalent FPGA toolchain. * Hands\-on experience with embedded Linux flows: building and customizing images with a Yocto\-based flow such as PetaLinux or the Embedded Design Flow (BSPs, device trees, kernel configuration, custom recipes and layers), Linux kernel and driver knowledge covering UIO and character drivers, interrupt routing, reserved memory and real\-time scheduling, strong C/C\+\+ for application and bare\-metal programming on embedded processors, and automation in Python, Tcl and Shell. Equivalent depth in OpenEmbedded, Buildroot, or AOSP build systems will be considered. * Working knowledge of clocking, CDC, timing closure and static timing analysis, with a proven ability to debug timing violations. * Proven experience in at least one of the following areas: performance analysis and tuning on real hardware; or boot and configuration flows on FPGA or SoC platforms, including boot image generation, platform management firmware, secure boot, bootloaders and runtime reconfiguration of programmable logic. * **Demonstrated use of AI in engineering workflows**, applying AI/LLM/ML tools to identify design gaps, summarize collected data for distribution and analysis, and drive productivity in debug, automation and documentation. * A track record of supporting customers directly, working cross\-functionally across design, software, validation and field teams, and running technical reviews. **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.** **\#LI\-RL1** Qualifications: *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, EC2 Nitro Networking
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to shape the future of virtualized networking in one of the world's largest public clouds? The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\) NX Platforms team owns the packet processing pipeline running beneath every EC2 instance — adding encryption, firewalls (security groups), routing, billing, and monitoring to every packet on every host across our worldwide fleet of 9M\+ hosts in more than 30 regions. Our vision: deliver bare\-metal networking performance while raising the bar on EC2's security, availability, and reliability — unlocking capabilities only possible through true Software Defined Networking (SDN). We are growing fast and looking for senior systems engineers who can deliver ultra\-high performance — our goal is processing millions of packets per second on a single CPU core. This demands highly optimized data structures, low\-level hardware tuning, and expertise in C/C\+\+. If you have a passion for systems software engineering — kernel development, embedded systems, or high\-performance networking — this is a unique opportunity to define the next generation of the platform powering all new EC2 instance families and VPC features for years to come. Your code ships to production across the entire EC2 fleet — powering services like AWS Lambda and every external workload running on EC2\. With frequent deployments and full ownership from design through operation, your contributions have immediate, measurable impact at global scale. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Sustainability Science and Innovation
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements to support Amazon's long term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon’s scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable. We are looking for an engineer to build the software and infrastructure that help scientists develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for sustainability applications. You will work directly with applied scientists, turning production\-grade science artifacts into reliable systems and building reusable tools that reduce the engineering work required for each new model. The work spans research workflows and production systems: preparing data for experiments, automating training and evaluation, and making models available through dependable interfaces. A central design challenge is deciding what the platform should handle consistently and where researchers need flexibility. Good abstractions let scientists change a model or transformation without rebuilding the surrounding infrastructure, while keeping the underlying system accessible when something needs to be understood or fixed. You will also develop interfaces and workflows that support AI\-assisted engineering. This includes making platform capabilities understandable to coding agents and building checks that verify their changes before those changes reach production. Key job responsibilities * Build reusable data and ML infrastructure. Develop libraries, configuration\-driven interfaces, and infrastructure\-as\-code components for data processing, model training, and inference. * Build tools for repeatable experiments and model comparisons, preserving the data, code, and configuration needed to investigate results. * Develop and evaluate AI\-assisted workflows. Create tooling that helps coding agents use the platform correctly. Assess their output through automated checks and appropriate review, and measure whether the workflows improve engineering productivity without weakening reliability. * Support adoption and evolution. Work with platform users to identify recurring needs, document design trade\-offs, and maintain compatibility as shared components change. About the team Our team brings together applied scientists and engineers to develop models and software for sustainability applications. We work across research and production, building both scientific methods and the systems needed to use them reliably. That combination keeps platform development close to the practical needs of researchers and the people who depend on their models. We build reusable tools so that each new research project does not require its own infrastructure. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Lambda
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Lambda changed how the world builds software. Developers write code, and Lambda runs it: no servers to provision or patch, and no capacity to plan. Every month, Lambda runs trillions of invocations for millions of customers, from startups to the largest enterprises. It powers web backends, APIs, data pipelines, event\-driven apps, and AI agents. We're looking for experienced engineers to lead the next generation of the Lambda data plane. The data plane is the set of distributed systems that receive, route, place, scale, and run every function invocation. It has to be fast, secure, and highly available at huge scale. We're also taking serverless into new areas. That includes new compute options like Lambda Managed Instances, first\-class support for web applications, and richer ways to process events at scale. As a senior engineer, you'll set the technical direction for these capabilities and turn it into production systems. This role suits builders who like hard distributed\-systems problems: the low\-latency invoke path, multi\-tenant isolation, capacity management and placement, fast scaling, cold\-start optimization, high\-throughput event processing, and operating services where every millisecond and every nine of availability counts. We work in Rust, Java, and C/C\+\+, from virtualization and microVMs (Firecracker) up to customer\-facing APIs. We're hiring for several data plane teams, so we welcome senior candidates from a range of backgrounds, whether that's large\-scale services, systems programming, virtualization, stream and event processing, or developer platforms. Key job responsibilities * Lead the architecture and design of large\-scale, highly available, low\-latency data plane systems that handle customer traffic across AWS Regions * Set technical direction across teams, balancing near\-term delivery with long\-term architecture, and influence the Lambda roadmap * Own complex, ambiguous problems end to end, from customer need to design, implementation, deployment, and operations * Drive major improvements in invoke latency, scaling speed, efficiency, security, and resilience * Help define and deliver new serverless compute experiences for web, event\-driven, and instance\-based workloads * Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar across the organization * Lead operational excellence: set standards for observability, deployment safety, and incident response, and drive lasting fixes * Work with product managers, engineering leaders, and partner AWS teams to deliver results for customers A day in the life You might start the day leading a design review for a new scaling mechanism, spend the afternoon digging into a tail\-latency problem across the invoke path, and wrap up mentoring an engineer through their first major design document. You'll work directly with customer feedback and production metrics, and your decisions will shape how Lambda evolves over the next several years. About the team AWS Lambda is part of AWS Serverless Compute. The Lambda data plane teams own the core invoke path, the worker fleet and virtualization layer, scaling and placement, event processing, and new compute models such as Lambda Managed Instances. We value ownership, operational excellence, and simplicity, and we invest in growing engineers at every level.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Experience designing, building, operating, and managing large\-scale distributed systems or web services * Experience with Java, C\+\+, or pother programming languages * Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems * Experience with enterprise\-scale infrastructure or development\-based cloud programs/projects in a related industry * Experience leading large teams, with demonstrable ability to hire, develop, and manage high\-performing technical teams Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Ads Demand Tech, Forecasting and Guidance
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Ads is growing rapidly — expanding into Live events, Streaming TV, and agentic solutions for advertisers — and the Amazon Ads Demand Tech: Forecasting Insights and Guidance team needs a Software Development Engineer to help build the systems behind it all. In this role you will design and deliver campaign forecasting and recommendation services that process petabyte\-scale data, power real\-time advertiser decisions, and directly influence how advertising budgets are planned and optimized. You will write production code in Java, Scala, Python, and TypeScript, build and operate large\-scale data pipelines and indexing infrastructure on AWS, and collaborate with applied scientists to turn forecasting models into reliable, performant services. A major focus ahead is scaling the platform for high\-throughput agentic workloads and applying AI to accelerate software upgrades and reduce operational recovery times. If you enjoy working across the full software lifecycle and want your work to have a measurable impact on a business growing at 26% year over year, this is a compelling time to join. Key job responsibilities * Design and implement scalable APIs and microservices that serve real\-time forecasting and recommendation results to advertising customers, with a near\-term focus on scaling throughput for agentic workloads * Build and maintain backend data pipelines on EMR, Spark, and S3 that process petabyte\-scale datasets, generate search indexes, and keep daily data fresh and accurate * Collaborate with applied scientists and product teams to translate time\-series forecasting models and supply\-demand algorithms into production\-ready, well\-tested systems * Apply AI\-driven approaches to accelerate platform upgrades, reduce tech debt, and lower mean time to resolution for operational issues * Mentor engineers on your team through code reviews and design discussions, contribute to technical roadmaps, and document systems so they can be maintained and extended by others A day in the life Your time splits between proactive, roadmap\-driven feature work and hands\-on operational responsibilities. In a typical week you might spend mornings writing and reviewing code — building a new forecasting endpoint or tuning a Spark indexing job — then shift to monitoring deployment pipelines, investigating a data\-quality anomaly, or reviewing dashboards for latency and forecast accuracy. You will regularly join design reviews and cross\-team syncs with product, UX, and science partners. The role operates with significant autonomy: you own your features end to end, but you are never working in isolation — peer reviews, on\-call collaboration, and mentoring newer engineers are woven into the rhythm of the week. About the team Amazon Ads Demand Tech: Forecasting Insights and Guidance builds customer\-facing forecasting and recommendation products that guide self\-service advertising customers throughout their campaign lifecycle. Our systems help advertisers understand budget allocation opportunities, plan effective campaigns, and optimize performance. With Amazon Ads expanding into Live events, Streaming TV, and agentic advertiser solutions, accurate forecasting is becoming even more critical, and our team is at the center of that growth. Looking ahead, we are investing in scaling our platform for high\-throughput agentic requests, using AI to accelerate upgrades across our software stack, and reducing operational recovery times. We are an inclusive group of engineers, scientists, and product managers who value clear documentation, shared on\-call ownership, and continuous improvement of our platform.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 3\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 3\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 3\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 3\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Lambda
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Serverless technologies are dramatically changing the business landscape for AWS customers large and small. AWS Lambda changed how the world builds software. Developers write code, and Lambda runs it: no servers to provision or patch, and no capacity to plan. Every month, Lambda runs trillions of invocations for millions of customers, from startups to the largest enterprises. It powers web backends, APIs, data pipelines, event\-driven apps, and AI agents. We're looking for experienced engineers to help lead our global\-scale Lambda data plane. The data plane is the set of distributed systems that receive, route, place, scale, and run every function invocation. It has to be fast, secure, and highly available at huge scale. We're also taking serverless into new areas. That includes new compute options like Lambda Managed Instances, first\-class support for web applications, and richer ways to process events at scale. As a senior engineer, you'll set the technical direction for these capabilities and turn it into production systems. A successful team member will exhibit creativity, empathy, and optimism as we push the boundaries of serverless computing in the cloud. We are inspired by what has come before and motivated to create what comes next. You'll thrive in this role if you are interested in large scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems, low latency request processing, and p100 anomalies. You are capable in one or more programming languages and open to learning new ones. You include customer experience when discussing engineering alternatives and value creating APIs that make "the right thing, the easy thing." You value operational sustainability and advocate for eliminating flaky tests as soon as possible. You also think having fun goes together with tackling hard problems like supercomputing, high availability, and building loosely coupled gRPC\-based microservices, all while continuing to securely and reliably handle massive traffic with millisecond latency. Key job responsibilities * Lead the architecture and design of large\-scale, highly available, low\-latency data plane systems that handle customer traffic across AWS Regions * Set technical direction across teams, balancing near\-term delivery with long\-term architecture, and influence the Lambda roadmap * Own complex, ambiguous problems end to end, from customer need to design, implementation, deployment, and operations * Drive major improvements in invoke latency, scaling speed, efficiency, security, and resilience * Help define and deliver new serverless compute experiences for web, event\-driven, and instance\-based workloads * Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar across the organization * Lead operational excellence: set standards for observability, deployment safety, and incident response, and drive lasting fixes * Work with product managers, engineering leaders, and partner AWS teams to deliver results for customers A day in the life You might start the day leading a design review for a new scaling mechanism, spend the afternoon digging into a tail\-latency problem across the invoke path, and wrap up mentoring an engineer through their first major design document. You'll work directly with customer feedback and production metrics, and your decisions will shape how Lambda evolves over the next several years. About the team AWS Lambda is part of AWS Serverless Compute. The Lambda data plane teams own the core invoke path, the worker fleet and virtualization layer, scaling and placement, event processing, and new compute models such as Lambda Managed Instances. We value ownership, operational excellence, and simplicity, and we invest in growing engineers at every level.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ad Performance & Delivery
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you ready to build advertising technology at massive scale? Amazon Advertising's Demand Side Platform (DSP) processes billions of ad impressions daily, and our pacing and optimization systems sit at the heart of it, deciding in real time how budgets are spent, how bids are priced, and how campaigns hit their goals. Join our Bid Strategies and Pacing team to build systems that optimize ad spend across large\-scale distributed infrastructure. Our systems consume live delivery signals, compute price adjustments, enforce budget caps, and distribute bidding instructions to a global fleet within seconds of each auction. As a Software Development Engineer, you'll work on systems undergoing a massive scale inflection. You'll build and operate distributed services, streaming data pipelines, and real\-time control systems, learning how the pieces fit together to drive campaign performance for advertisers ranging from small businesses to large enterprises. You'll have ownership over your features end\-to\-end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. Working alongside applied scientists, economists, product managers, and senior engineers, you'll build both the distributed infrastructure and the optimization algorithms that run on it, growing your expertise across systems engineering, real\-time processing, and applied science. Key job responsibilities * Design and implement components of real\-time systems that compute price signals, enforce budget caps, and distribute bidding instructions across a globally distributed fleet * Build and operate distributed services and streaming data pipelines that process tens of billions of events daily * Contribute to campaign performance optimization: pacing algorithms, budget allocation, and bid strategy enforcement * Own features end\-to\-end through the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment and operations * Collaborate with applied scientists and economists to bring optimization algorithms from research to production * Participate in operational excellence: on\-call rotations, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system reliability A day in the life You'll work closely with applied scientists, economists, product managers, and senior engineers to build campaign optimization systems at scale. On any given day you might be implementing a new feature in a distributed service, writing integration tests for a streaming pipeline, pairing with a scientist to productionize an algorithm, or investigating an operational issue. You'll get exposure to control theory, distributed systems, and applied science, with mentorship and room to grow. About the team The Bidding Strategies and Pacing team is part of Amazon DSP, building the systems that pace and optimize campaign delivery. We determine how ads are bid on, how budgets are spent over time, and how campaigns meet their performance objectives, across the full spectrum of advertisers on the platform. Our systems operate at the intersection of control theory, distributed systems engineering, and applied science, and we're actively scaling them by orders of magnitude to support Amazon's next generation of advertising demand. If you want to build systems that are real\-time, distributed, and revenue\-critical, this is the team.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Generative Data Platform, Evaluation
jobs.description: Apple's machine learning features are only as good as the data behind them, and our team builds the platform that lets teams create data that fills the gaps real\-world collection can't, provides privacy\-preserving ways to train and evaluate our models safely, and helps us ensure our products have seen diverse inputs to generalize properly across the many parts of the world where we operate. In the AI \& Machine Learning (AIML) organization, our team builds the self\-service tools and platform that turn ideas, text, and images into large\-scale generated datasets. We don't produce the datasets ourselves: ML engineers, data scientists, designers, feature teams, ML data operations teams, and Safety and Responsible AI teams across Apple use our platform to generate their own. That data is only valuable if it matches the real world closely enough to train on and to evaluate against, proving our models and features meet Apple's quality bar before they reach customers. jobs.title: Sr Machine Learning Engineer, Proactive
jobs.description: At Apple, machine learning powers experiences that anticipate what people need before they ask. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help build the next generation of intelligent search and AI experiences technology that understands user intent, context, and personal information while preserving privacy. In this role, you'll design, train, fine\-tune, optimize, and deploy large language models, semantic retrieval systems, and ranking models that power relevant, personalized, and context\-aware experiences across Apple's ecosystem. **Description** You'll design, train, fine\-tune, and optimize transformer\-based language models and foundation models for efficient on\-device deployment, and build semantic retrieval, embedding, reranking, and retrieval\-augmented generation systems that improve search quality and AI\-powered experiences. You'll develop models for query understanding, intent prediction, personalization, retrieval, and ranking, while researching new approaches to LLM fine\-tuning, knowledge distillation, model compression, quantization, and low\-latency inference. You'll explore techniques for adapting large foundation models into smaller, highly capable models that can operate efficiently under on\-device memory, compute, power, and latency constraints. You'll partner with engineers, researchers, product managers, and designers to bring new AI capabilities from research into production, driving technical strategy and leading projects from early exploration through large\-scale deployment. This is an opportunity to explore new applications of foundation models, multimodal AI, agentic retrieval, and personalized intelligence, shaping the next generation of proactive and intelligent user experiences.","responsibilities":"Build semantic retrieval, embedding, reranking, and retrieval\-augmented generation systems, along with models for query understanding, intent prediction, personalization, retrieval, and ranking. Analyze search relevance and user behavior to design evaluation methodologies, offline benchmarks, and online metrics that measure retrieval quality, ranking, personalization, and language model performance. Build scalable experimentation and evaluation pipelines for LLMs and search models, including model quality, robustness, latency, efficiency, and end\-to\-end product metrics. Design, train, fine\-tune, distill, and optimize transformer\-based language models and foundation models for efficient on\-device deployment. Develop LLM fine\-tuning and post\-training approaches, including supervised fine\-tuning, instruction tuning, preference optimization, parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning, and task\-specific adaptation. Research and prototype approaches for on\-device generative AI, including knowledge distillation, model compression, quantization, pruning, and low\-latency inference. Develop techniques to transfer capabilities from large foundation models into compact on\-device models while balancing model quality, latency, memory footprint, power consumption, and compute constraints. Partner with engineers, researchers, product managers, and designers to bring AI capabilities from research into production, driving technical strategy across projects and exploring new applications of foundation models, multimodal AI, agentic retrieval, and personalized intelligence. **Preferred Qualifications** Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Experience optimizing machine learning models for resource\-constrained environments, including knowledge distillation, model compression, quantization, and pruning. Experience with on\-device machine learning or edge AI, or mobile inference frameworks, including optimizing models for latency, memory, compute, and power constraints. Experience distilling capabilities from large foundation models into small language models or task\-specific models for efficient inference. Experience building retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, embedding retrieval, neural reranking, or semantic search systems. Experience with query understanding, query rewriting, intent classification, personalized retrieval, learning\-to\-rank, or recommendation models. Experience working with transformer architectures and foundation model families such as BERT, T5, Llama, Gemma, Mistral, or related architectures. Experience evaluating language models, designing AI quality metrics, and building automated and human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation pipelines. Experience building large\-scale production search, recommendation, personalization, or generative AI systems. Familiarity with multimodal foundation models, tool use, agentic AI, or agentic retrieval systems. Strong understanding of the tradeoffs among model quality, latency, memory, power consumption, privacy, and reliability for production on\-device AI systems. Ability to prototype new ideas, conduct rigorous experiments, solve ambiguous technical problems, and translate research advances into production\-quality machine learning solutions. **Minimum Qualifications** Master degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. 5\+ years of industry or research experience developing machine learning systems. Background in machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, information retrieval, search, recommender systems, or generative AI. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer — Full\-Time Startup Role Company: Bounds Hay is building Hay X an Inventory Management Software for agriculture. Hay X Job Type: Full\-timeLocation: Junction City, Oregon. About Hay X Hay X is building software that helps hay growers, buyers, brokers, and trucking companies manage their daily operations. Our platform brings together inventory, weight tickets, dispatch, sales, contracts, invoicing, and communication. We’re looking for an experienced software engineer who wants to commit full time to building and growing a startup. You’ll work directly with the founder and our development team to turn real customer problems into simple, reliable software. Former founders and technical co\-founders are encouraged to apply. We value people who have experienced the responsibility, uncertainty, and persistence it takes to build a business. The Role This is a hands\-on engineering position with significant responsibility. You’ll help improve the existing product, build new features, and make technical decisions that support growth. We need someone who takes initiative, works hard, follows through, and cares about whether customers actually use what we build. You should be comfortable working through incomplete requirements, asking thoughtful questions, and carrying a feature from idea through launch. What You’ll Do * Build and maintain features across our web and mobile platform. * Work directly with the founder to understand customer workflows and priorities. * Simplify how customers manage inventory, weight tickets, loads, sales, and invoices. * Improve reliability, performance, and the overall user experience. * Develop APIs and integrations with external services. * Investigate bugs, address root causes, and support customers when issues arise. * Collaborate with the development team through code reviews and clear communication. * Take ownership of features from planning through release and follow\-up improvements. * Balance speed with maintainable code, testing, and sound technical decisions. What We’re Looking For * Strong experience building and shipping production software. * Full\-stack development experience, including frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and databases. * Experience working on a startup or a small team with substantial individual responsibility. * Ability to turn complex business workflows into straightforward user experiences. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently. * Clear communication, dependable follow\-through, and attention to detail. * Willingness to make Hay X your primary, full\-time professional commitment. * A practical approach to AI development tools, with responsibility for reviewing and validating the results. Especially Valuable * Experience as a founder or technical co\-founder. * Experience growing a product from early users to broader adoption. * Experience with mobile applications, SaaS, marketplaces, or business management software. * Familiarity with agriculture, trucking, logistics, inventory, or accounting workflows. Agricultural experience is helpful but not required. Curiosity and a willingness to learn our customers’ businesses are essential. Why Join Hay X? You’ll have direct access to the founder, meaningful input into the product, and the opportunity to see your work used in real businesses. We’re looking for someone who wants to help build the company over time and take pride in the result. How to Apply Please submit your resume and a brief note covering: * A product or company you helped build and your specific contribution. * Any founder or startup experience. * Why you want to work full time on Hay X. * Links to relevant projects, your portfolio, or GitHub, if available. Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast\-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking **Full\-stack Software Engineers** who are passionate about leveraging cutting\-edge open source frameworks and emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across Capital One. **Shape the Next Era of Auto Sales Tech** At Capital One’s FS Tech division, we are pioneering the future state of Auto Sales by combining data\-driven decision\-making with powerful AI capabilities built on our Gen AI platform. Our industry\-leading tools—like Auto Navigator for consumers and Dealer Navigator for automotive dealerships—redefine how millions navigate vehicle ownership. We are expanding our Sales Tech organization with a brand\-new End\-to\-End Strategy \& Innovation Team. Our mission is to transform Capital One’s enterprise sales force. If you thrive on leveraging data\-driven insights, advancing AI capabilities on modern platforms, and replacing manual operational workflows with intelligent automation, join us in architecting scalable solutions from scratch. **What You’ll Do:** * Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in distributed microservices, and full stack systems to create solutions that help meet regulatory needs for the company * Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal \& external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community * Collaborate with digital product managers, and deliver robust cloud\-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment * Utilize programming languages like Java, Scala, Python, Go, Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, Open Source RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Container Orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, and a variety of AWS tools and services * Provide technical leadership and direction across Agile teams, setting standards for design, development, and operational excellence * Partner with architects to define service boundaries, integration patterns, and reusable frameworks * Proactively identify areas for improvement, implementing targeted refactoring and contributing to efforts that reduce technical debt and enhance system performance * Influence long\-term technology strategy through evaluation of emerging tools and practices in a ‘you build it, you own it’ environment **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud\-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field * 7\+ years of experience coding with more than two of the following: Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C\#, Scala * 3\+ years of experience with database and database management systems * 3\+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or cloud\-based productivity tools or virtualization technologies * 4\+ years of experience contributing to open source frameworks * 3\+ years of experience with front\-end JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks * 4\+ years of experience creating synchronous and asynchronous APIs * 3\+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing frameworks * 3\+ years of experience using Git\-based version\-control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, Bitbucket) * 3\+ years of experience troubleshooting technical issues within cloud environments * Experience leveraging modern AI\-based coding tools and IDE copilots * 1\+ year of experience mentoring engineers and driving professional development within technical teams * 1\+ year of experience leveraging observability to identify and optimize performance bottlenecks in distributed systems * Experience with interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code completion * Experience leading cross\-functional engineering efforts or large\-scale technical initiatives * Experience establishing and enforcing coding standards and design patterns across teams * Experience designing, building, or maintaining production\-grade data pipelines, data warehouses, or real\-time analytics systems. * Demonstrated track record of identifying operational bottlenecks and redesigning end\-to\-end workflows to improve performance or efficiency. * Experience breaking down high\-level, multi\-year business objectives into actionable technical milestones and roadmaps. * Hands\-on experience developing automated workflows to replace legacy or manual operational processes. ***At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, F\-1 CPT, J\-1, TN, E\-3, and O\-1, or any other forms of Duties include but are not limited to compiling data; generating reports; reviewing and analyzing legal and financial issues pertinent to the environmental office and coordinating public information. **Supervision Received:** Works under very general supervision. inclusive.* * Examines customer water usage and completes water use surveys, cross\-connection testing, and various testing procedures to identify the requirement for backflow prevention assemblies jobs.title: Director of Parks and Recreation
jobs.description: The Director of Parks and Recreation provides strategic leadership, administrative direction, and oversight of all activities of the Parks and Recreation Department (excluding Golf and Library), including, but not limited to city parks, special events, recreation programs and facilities, public art initiatives, trails, park operations and maintenance, facility operations and maintenance, capital, projects, and all relevant items pertaining to the department. This position develops, implements, and enforces policies, programs, and initiatives that enhance quality of life and promote community well\-being. The Director enforces and sets expectations and standards of excellence, collaborating with department leadership to ensure quality and performance align accordingly. This position requires strong leadership, creativity, and independent judgement. Works under minimal supervision with considerable latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgement. **Essential Duties \& Required Qualifications** ----------------------------------------------- * Provides high\-level support to the Executive Director by driving the execution of department priorities, translating strategic direction into actionable initiatives, ensuring operational alignment across divisions, and advancing organizational goals through proactive leadership. * Direct the activities of the Parks and Recreation Department, which include planning, coordinating, administering, and evaluating programs, projects, processes, procedures, systems, standards, and / or service offerings; ensures compliance with federal, state, and local laws, regulations, codes, and / or standards. * Supervise direct reports including interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding, coaching and counseling, employees and recommendation for dismissal; addressing complaints and resolving problems. * Act as a liaison to select community groups, private sector, quasi\-public, and governmental agencies, educational institutions, businesses, non\-profit groups, various boards and resident groups to advance the overall goals of the department. * Establish appropriate service and staffing levels; monitor and evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of programs, service delivery methods and procedures; and allocate resources accordingly. * Actively participate in City and department\-wide initiatives, activities, and special events maintaining a strong and visible presence that supports staff, reinforces department priorities, and upholds established quality, safety, and service standards. * Foster a positive workplace culture and support staff development through mentorship, training opportunities, and ongoing professional growth. * Support collaboration across the Parks and Recreation Department divisions by cultivating positive working relationships, encouraging cross\-divisional partnerships, and aligning services with broader department goals. * Demonstrate strong leadership and clear communication by fostering transparency, actively engaging staff, and representing the department’s interests while contributing to a unified vision. * Plan, manage, and monitor the proper allocation and utilization of staff according to projected needs and directives. Administer and carry out City policies and procedures in a supportive and productive manner. * Lead the development and administration of the department budget; approve the forecast of funds needed for staffing, equipment, materials and supplies, capital projects; approve expenditures; and implement budgetary adjustments as appropriate and necessary. * Lead grant writing and submission. * Lead for department capital projects. * Take lead in investigating and resolving complex or sensitive citizen complaints or problems. * Prepare reviews, analyze, and evaluate a variety of narrative and statistical data and feedback regarding division programs, services, and activities to monitor success in terms of utilization, customer satisfaction, cost effectiveness, and overall value to the community. * Plan for the department’s future in all aspects which includes, strategic planning and goal setting, capital improvement programs, alterations to existing buildings and construction of new facilities. * Stay current with the profession’s methodology, practices, trends, and issues. * Develop and strengthen professional and administrative knowledge and skills. Remain visible within the professional community. * Leads the development and implementation of the Parks and Recreation Master Plan and other long\-term strategic plans to ensure alignment with City priorities and goals. * Collaborate with the Development Services Department to review and facilitate park dedication and development proposals. * Oversee the protection, stewardship, and sustainable use of the City’s parks, trails, open spaces, and natural resources. * Conducts community needs assessments and an ons. * Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. * Ability to follow detailed verbal and written instructions. * Ability to read and comprehend documents related to operation and training manuals, memos, policies and procedures. * Ability to communicate with other employees and the public in a courteous and diplomatic manner. * Analyze situations and adopt quick, effect, and reasonable courses of action. * Skill in handling multiple tasks and prioritizing. * Ability to plan and schedule operations. * Knowledge of methods and techniques of scheduling work assignments; methods and techniques for record keeping and report preparation and writing with proper punctuation, spelling and grammar. * Skill in directing the activities of a complex and diverse organization. * Skill in using computers and related software applications. * Skill in data analysis and problem solving. * Ability to develop and implement strategic goals and policies. * Skilled in problem\-solving, critical thinking, and decision\-making. * Skilled in public speaking, advocacy, and representing the department to the community and stakeholders. * Ability to collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary department. * Ability to assess community needs and adapt services accordingly. * Ability to work flexible hours, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and on\-call duties as required. **Physical Demands \& Additional Information** ---------------------------------------------- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to handle and feel items, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, talk, and hear. jobs.description: The CoCreate Group is seeking motivated sales representatives to introduce small and medium\-sized businesses to practical AI education, business automation, digital systems, and managed AI services. Businesses that want help beyond training can hire The CoCreate Group to design, install, integrate, optimize, and manage their business systems. Representatives may prospect through: * In\-person business visits * Networking * Phone outreach * Email * Social media * Referrals * Local business organizations * Scheduled appointments The initial conversation does not have to begin with a sale. The training is free.”** If the business only wants the education, that's fine. If the owner wants someone to actually design, connect, automate, implement, and manage the systems, that is where our paid services begin. CRM systems * Lead pipelines * Workflow automation * Cross\-platform integrations * File organization * Data cleanup * Notifications * Backups Business Administration * Invoice workflows * Payment links * AR follow\-up * Estimate systems * KPI dashboards * Receipt workflows * Renewal calendars * COI and document tracking Sales \& Owner Productivity * Propos cted managed systems** Designed for businesses seeking broader operational transformation. Bespoke Advanced technical and custom projects are individually scoped and quoted. These may include: * AI Harnesses * MCP systems * APIs * Advanced retrieval architectures * Custom databases * Custom applications * Complex websites * GEO/AIO programs * Hardware deployments * Custom integrations The Second Look — $149 Businesses that aren't ready for a managed plan can begin with **The Second Look**. We examine the company's systems, processes, bottlenecks, digital presence, and opportunities for improvement. The $149 is credited toward an eligible installation purchased within 30 days. Why This Position Is Different You don't have to walk into businesses saying: **“Can I sell you something?”** You can begin with: **“Can we teach your business something useful about AI for free?”** You're also not selling one disposable product. New clients pay the representative **20% commission**, with a qualifying weekly accelerated sale paying **25%**. Qualifying annual renewals then pay the originating representative **10% recurring commission**. A representative who continues adding new clients can therefore build a growing renewal portfolio over time. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world. **Job Summary** This job involves assisting in the design, development, and maintenance of software applications. It debugs software to optimize performance, participates in code reviews for continuous improvement, and implements testing protocols to ensure reliability. It writes technical documentation and works with Quality Assurance to verify that applications meet specifications and user requirements.**Job Description** **Responsibilities:** * Assisting with the design, development, and maintenance of software applications using appropriate programming languages * Participating in code reviews, providing feedback for continuous development process improvement * Implementing testing protocols to identify bugs, enhance performance, and ensure application reliability * Participating in agile development practices, including sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives, to enhance team collaboration and project management * Staying informed on emerging technologies to suggest innovative solutions for software functionality * Writing and editing technical documentation to support software design and application requirements * Reviewing literature, patents, and current practices relevant to assigned projects to support the development of robust software functionality * Working with Quality Assurance to ensure applications meet technical specifications and user needs * Debugging software to enhance performance and user experience * Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance. * Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary. * Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **Employees at all levels are expected to:*** Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job. * Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services. * Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences. * Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas. * Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers. * Drive results and growth. * Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead. * Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities. **Disclaimer:** This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. jobs.title: Senior Software Security Engineer - District Attorney
jobs.description: **For questions regarding this position, please contact the Recruiter listed in the Supplemental Information section.** **ABOUT THE POSITION** ---------------------- The Office of the District Attorney is seeking a Senior Software Security Engineer (Senior District Attorney Software Engineer) for the Riverside location. The Software Engineering team within the Riverside County District Attorney’s Office has designed and built a sophisticated software platform entirely in house to support the complex operations of a modern DA legal environment. The system has grown to encompass interconnected services and multiple modules, including case management, transaction processing, reporting, data management, and real time integrations with external agencies. As the system continues to grow, security and software compliance have become increasingly critical to its design, development, and maintenance. The Senior Software Security Engineer will play a key role in designing, implementing, reviewing, and maintaining security controls across the platform, ensuring that security is built into services and architecture from the ground up. This includes protecting against threats such as malicious JavaScript, denial of service attacks, session hijacking, SQL injection, broken access control, authentication failures, security misconfigurations, and improper handling of audit and exception logs. The role will also support the security of integrations with external partners, as well as the secure management and rotation of keys, credentials, certificates, and configurations. Working alongside experienced software engineers, the Senior Software Security Engineer will be key in engineering decisions that affect the security, reliability, and compliance of the system while keeping pace with evolving security standards and software compliance requirements. If you are looking for a challenging work that truly matters, we would love to hear from you! **Meet the Team!** The District Attorney of Riverside County, as the public prosecutor acting on behalf of the People, vigorously enforces the law, pursues the truth, protects those victimized by crime, exonerates the innocent, and safeguards the rights of all to ensure that justice is done on behalf of our community. The office’s staff of over 700 is comprised of prosecuting attorneys, sworn investigators, victim\-witness advocates, paralegals, investigative technicians, forensic analysts, and a wide range of information technology and supporting staff all committed to excellence and integrity in public service. We are, and we seek to maintain, a diverse workforce to match a diverse county. jfc:15103200 **EXAMPLES OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES** -------------------------------- * Build security into enterprise software system components from the ground\-up that are reliable, maintainable, scalable, secure, and reusable. Have the ability to learn and keep up with various software compliance checklists and rules, such as Trusted Systems, Racial Justice Act, E\-Sign Act, CJIS, Telephone Act, ADA, and others. * Build security controls into Web APIs and their underlying architecture to interconnect subsystems. * Keep up with security standards and Implement up to date security engineering practices * Build security into front\-end and back\-end software features by understanding a variety of software engineering/programming languages for example html, CS, Javascript, C\#, C\+\+, Angular, TypeScript, Bootstrap, Web API (REST, RPC), SQL, PowerShell * Build high performing database objects and functions utilizing Microsoft SQL, Transaction SQL, Stored Procedures, Profiling, and Optimization plans. * Develop and maintain data warehouse and transaction database architecture and file system. * Develop scripts and scheduled jobs for software transaction data migration, and maintain database version compatibility with software back\-end. * Maintain and enhance security into existing software systems. * Participate in DevOps builds and releases, including DevSecOps Development Security Operations. * Ensure software features continue to work properly after maintenance and testing. * Investigate and resolve security failures during upgrades using various troubleshooting tools. * Participate in the support for any software issues that may arise in all environments from development through production. * Maintain and monitor security in various layers of the system from operating system configurations as it relates to the software front\-end and library publishing packages, NuGet packages and repositories. Generate and keep a repository of security keys and certificates securely. * lead and support staff involved in designing, developing, and implementing security controls into the enterprise software for the DA; coach and mentor staff. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** -------------------------- **Education:** Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor's degree in computer science, computer/soft ork arrangements are subject to management approval, operational needs, and/or may be modified or discontinued at any time. Employees who telework are expected to be able to report to their assigned worksite on short notice or as operational needs require. Unless otherwise specified for a particular position, employees are expected to reside in California following appointment. Limited exceptions may apply. Applicants should contact the assigned recruiter for additional information regarding work location expectations, telework eligibility, and residency requirements. **Proof of Education** If using education to qualify or when requested by the recruiter, upload a copy of any license(s), official/unofficial transcript(s), degrees, and/or related employment documents to your NeoGov account at the time of application and before the closing date. Official or unofficial transcripts will be accepted. If your education was completed outside of the United States, you will need to provide a copy of your Foreign Education Equivalency evaluation from a member of the National Association of Credential Evaluation Services (NACES) or Association of International Credential Evaluators, Inc. (AICE). **Work Authorization Requirement** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. The County of Riverside does not participate in visa sponsorship programs, including H1\-B visas, and will not provide sponsorship for any employment\-based visas. **Equal Opportunity Employer** The County of Riverside is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of the County of Riverside to provide equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, ancestry, medical condition (cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, or denial of medical and family care leave, or any other non\-job\-related factors. **Pre\-Employment** All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of pre\-employment requirements including a criminal background investigation, which involves fingerprinting. (A felony or misdemeanor conviction may disqualify the applicant from County employment). A pre\-employment physical examination and background check may be required. **Probationary Period** As an Approved Local Merit System, all County of Riverside employees, except those serving "At Will," are subject to the probationary period provisions as specified in the applicable Memorandum of Understanding, County Resolution, or Salary Ordinance. Qualified candidates may be considered for future County vacancies. Job postings may close without notice based on application volume.
